title: Joy in a measure for two

captions.emotions: Feeling your differences find an accord

meaning: Your care can bring calm pleasure when dependable preparation considers different ways of resting together.
text: A pleasant meeting need not be equally elaborate for both of you. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through definite responsibility: organising time, keeping promises and preparing necessities. The Sun in energy gives a wish to share pleasure openly and see a warm response. Temperance in emotions brings a sense of fitting measure when different needs can be combined. Tenderness can exist in a well-prepared evening that is allowed to become simpler than first imagined. The main pleasure comes from involvement between two people rather than compulsory completion of the whole programme.

For example, you plan to cook several complicated dishes together. Ingredients are bought and time reserved, but one person suggests a simpler dinner. **Care can preserve joy by reducing the scale.** You choose one dish and spend longer at the table. Preparations were not wasted: they made meeting possible, while clarification helped find an appropriate rhythm. You need not enjoy lengthy cooking equally to share pleasure in the evening.

The difficulty is turning agreement to a simpler option into a silent concession that loses its own voice. Everything looks convenient while resentment remains about the postponed idea. Calm depends on removing an actual wish from conversation. A warm measure emerges when pleasure in being together and regret about what remained undone can both be named without making one an accusation against the other.
